cs.t: I used Edifier WH950NB and I really like it. I used them every day for at least 3 to 4 hours for almost 2 years now, and they are like brand new. Very comfortable, good sound quality (not an expert by any means) and the battery duration is good considering that I used them always with noise cancelling on. It sounds good on calls and without ANC environment sounds are ok to keep a conversation. PD: I realize this looks a little bit like an ad. It is not, I just like the product.
cs.th: Looking for a good pair of over ear headphones
